levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن محمد بن جمهور

notes: «جميعا» joins the two first transmitters, whose routes meet at Hasan b. Muhammad b. Jumhur.
The Imam named in the saying's words («قال أمير المؤمنين على المنبر») is the last link, kind imam_in_text (owner ruling 2). The leading «4 -» is a report number.
